title: Partner Utility Program Schedule: Slab Access Rates for Utility Line Protection Plans
content:
# Partner Utility Program Schedule: Slab Access Rates

Partner programs schedule for the Bridgewell Utility Line Protection Plans.

## Rule

Slab partner schedule rate: a plan enrolled through Prairie Gas and Light whose premium has been remitted through that utility's bill within the slab partner window takes the Prairie slab rate; a plan enrolled through Tri-County Electric Cooperative whose premium has been remitted through that utility's bill within the slab partner window takes the Tri-County slab rate; every other plan takes a slab partner schedule rate of one. Slab windows counted in months run back from the day the payment is booked: an entry falls within a slab window when fewer whole months than the window separate its posting date from that day. The slab partner schedule rate multiplies the plan's slab access allowance in the slab access figure.

## Schedule

| Partner utility the plan was enrolled through | Premium remitted through that utility's bill within the 12-month slab partner window | Slab partner schedule rate |
|---|---|---|
| Prairie Gas and Light | yes | 1.15 (Prairie slab rate) |
| Tri-County Electric Cooperative | yes | 1.1 (Tri-County slab rate) |
| Prairie Gas and Light or Tri-County Electric Cooperative | no | 1 |
| any other partner utility, or a direct enrollment | either | 1 |

## The 12-month window

The slab partner window is 12 months, counted back from the day the slab access payment is booked. A premium payment posted with the utility bill as its payment method falls within the window when fewer than 12 whole months separate its posting date from that day.

*Hypothetical boundary cases (payment booked on 15 June 2026):* a utility-bill remittance posted on 16 June 2025 is 11 whole months back and falls within the window; one posted on 15 June 2025 is 12 whole months back and does not.

## Hypothetical example

A plan enrolled through Prairie Gas and Light with a utility-bill remittance posted two months before booking, and an allowance of $500.00 assumed: $500.00 multiplied by 1.15 is $575.00.
